LESSON: HILI NA HAYA

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.28: Hili na Haya

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Hili na Haya. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya
3. practise Hili na Haya in clear steps
4. apply Hili na Haya in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HILI NA HAYA
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hili na Haya helps you succeed in KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: HILI NA HAYA
Study Hili na Haya like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Hili na Haya”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Hili na Haya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Hili na Haya in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Hili na Haya in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Hili na Haya in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Hili na Haya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Hili na Haya in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Hili na Haya in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Hili na Haya in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Hili na Haya in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Hili na Haya”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Hili na Haya in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hili na Haya is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Hili na Haya”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Hili na Haya. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Hili na Haya. (skill: practise Hili na Haya in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Hili na Haya”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Hili na Haya in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hili na Haya to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Hili na Haya in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hili na Haya from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hili na Haya: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Hili na Haya?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Hili na Haya means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Hili na Haya means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Hili na Haya from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
